original_bug_description: Heap-use-after-free in xbuf_format_converter (main/spprintf.c): xbuf_format_converter performs a strlen on a buffer that has already been freed while building formatted strings via zend_vstrpprintf / zend_error_va_list. This read-after-free is reachable from error/convert paths (observed during string-to-long conversion in bitwise AND handling) and can cause process crashes or other memory-corruption issues when triggered.
